source: EPM Geoportal - Mapa de redes de energía
what_it_supports: Primary place to inspect operating EPM network geometry/assets around the exact community
use_in_model: Trace actual MV/LV route, identify visible transformers/assets and voltage fields exposed by EPM

what_it_supports: EPM connection workflow checks network availability and requests generation capacity, transformer capacity, voltage and point-of-connection data
use_in_model: Defines the practical connection/approval context for PV export cases
caution: Formal acceptance is through EPM availability/connection process, not a simple universal inverter-to-transformer ratio.

what_it_supports: For inverter-based generation, installed/nominal generation capacity is the sum of AC inverter nominal active-power ratings
use_in_model: Use inverter AC rating as the declared generation-capacity variable
caution: Does not by itself establish a blanket rule that inverter kW must numerically equal or stay below transformer kVA.

what_it_supports: EPM requires load flow with and without project, short-circuit analysis, IEEE 1547 declaration and protection checks for applicable AGPE/GD studies
use_in_model: Direct justification for the pandapower grid-impact stage
caution: Required study depth depends on project size and network-availability outcome.
